definitions.explanation: a collective term for animals that live in water, including fish, shellfish, marine mammals, and other aquatic creatures

examples.japanese: {水族|すいぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生態|せいたい}→生態：13543_seitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To study the ecology of aquatic life.

examples.japanese: {水族|すいぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The protection of marine life has become an important issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{海域|かいいき}→海域：26897_kaiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多種多様|たしゅたよう}→多種多様：15329_tashutayou⟧な{水族|すいぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: A wide variety of aquatic species inhabit these waters, attracting the attention of researchers.

notes:
Combines {水|すい} (water) and {族|ぞく} (group, family). Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{水族館|すいぞくかん}→水族館：09220_suizokukan⟧ (aquarium). As a standalone word, it has a somewhat literary or scientific tone and refers broadly to aquatic animals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{水族館|すいぞくかん}→水族館：09220_suizokukan⟧: aquarium (the most frequent compound)
- {水族|すいぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧: aquatic life exhibit
- {水族|すいぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧: keeping of aquatic animals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海洋生物|かいようせいぶつ}→海洋生物：24523_kaiyouseibutsu⟧: marine organisms — a broader scientific term including plants and microorganisms
- ⟦{魚類|ぎょるい}→魚類：04925_gyorui⟧: fish — specifically the class of fish
- {水生動物|すいせいどうぶつ}: aquatic animals — a more technical synonym
